name: codex-openpe-hotkey
description: Enhance selected Codex desktop prompts with a configurable hotkey, defaulting to Option+Q on macOS and Alt+Q on Windows, with inline progress.

interface.shortDescription: Configurable prompt hotkeys with inline progress.
interface.longDescription: Installs, configures, and diagnoses macOS and Windows helpers that enhance selected Codex prompts through openPE while showing animated progress inside the composer.
defaultPrompt: Install and verify OpenPE prompt enhancement for this desktop platform.
